Fall for Niagara Tour from Toronto
services.desc: Guided day tour from Toronto to Niagara Falls with scenic Parkway stops, free time at the Falls, and optional boat and Skylon Tower upgrades. No driving, no stress...just the easiest way to see Niagara Falls from Toronto.

includes: Round-trip transportation from Toronto in air-conditioned vehicle
Live commentary from a licensed tour guide throughout the day
Scenic stops and photo opportunities along Niagara River Parkway
Maple syrup tasting experience at Maple Leaf Place
Free time at Niagara Falls to explore, shop, and enjoy optional attractions
Duration 9 Hours About Your tour includes close-up viewing at the brink of the Canadian Horseshoe Falls with free time to explore.
blurb: Chariots of Fire offers a fully guided bus tour from Toronto to Niagara Falls Canada, including scenic stops along the Niagara Parkway and free time to explore the Falls. The tour includes live commentary, a maple syrup tasting experience, and optional add-ons like the Skylon Tower observation deck and Hornblower Niagara Cruises boat ride. The tour departs from Ripley's Aquarium of Canada and returns the same day.
